description: This file contains JavaScript functions for filtering and exporting calendar events, including URL conversion, event filtering based on user input, and dynamic content generation from Google Calendar API data.

methods.name: ucfirst
methods.description: Capitalizes the first letter of a string and makes the rest lowercase.

methods.name: String.prototype.convertirURL
methods.description: Converts URLs in a string into clickable links.

methods.name: filter_calendar
methods.description: Filters calendar events based on user input, fetches events from Google Calendar API, and dynamically updates the webpage with filtered events.
